  • Participar do desenho de soluções de software, aplicando conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços, DDD, Arquitetura Hexagonal e Clean Code.
  • Escrever código limpo, eficiente e de alta qualidade em Kotlin e Java, contribuindo para o padrão técnico do time.
  • Defender e promover uma cultura de qualidade, incentivando práticas como TDD e revisões de código criteriosas.
  • Garantir que as aplicações sejam instrumentadas para extração de métricas, logs e informações de performance, contribuindo para análise e otimização contínua.
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes e bugs complexos, conduzindo a identificação de causa raiz e implementação de soluções definitivas.
  • Incorporar o uso de ferramentas de IA e fluxos agênticos no dia a dia do time, promovendo ganhos de produtividade, qualidade e velocidade de entrega. 

Requisitos para este desafio:

  • Sólida experiência e fluência em linguagens orientadas a objeto, especialmente Java e Kotlin.
  • Domínio de arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Conhecimento prático de TDD, DDD, Clean Code e Arquitetura Hexagonal.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) em todo o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento.
  • Habilidade de solucionar problemas complexos e comunicar soluções de forma clara para times técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Domínio de GIT e Git Flow.
  • Experiência prática com Cloud AWS, Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Interesse genuíno e vivência prática no uso de ferramentas de IA generativa e fluxos agênticos aplicados ao desenvolvimento de software (ex: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou similares).

[Opcional] Diferenciais:

  • Experiência avançada com Spring Boot e/ou Javalin.
  • Vivência sólida com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, SQS).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados NoSQL.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de API Management como Apigee e o ecossistema Node.js para gerenciamento de APIs.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


We are looking for a Tech LeadFullstack Developer to join our team!
This role will be primarily focused on Frontend development (70%), with 30% Backend, working in a modern, collaborative environment focused on software engineering best practices.

Building user interfaces with React;
Working with relational and NoSQL databases;
Developing automated tests and applying software quality practices;
Working with messaging and event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus/Rebus;
Contributing to CI/CD processes using Azure DevOps and Azure Pipelines;
Working with Git and branching strategies such as GitFlow.
If you have experience with React + .NET/C# and are excited about this opportunity, we’d love to hear from you!

vagas.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


We are looking for a Senior QA, focused on Automation, to join our team!

Position Overview:
As a Senior QA, you will play a role in ensuring the quality and integrity of both automated and manual test cases. Your primary responsibility will be to define and validate test scenarios, manage risks, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure  our quality, driving excellence in our project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:
- Planning and executing functional and exploratory tests.
- Knowledge in API and front-end test automation.
- Experience with tools such as Selenium, Postman, Appium, or similar.
- Experience as a QA in agile teams.
- Ability to write good test scenarios and Test Plans and analyze technical functional requirements.
- Testing APIs (Postman, Rest Assured, Swagger, etc.).
- Test automation (Cypress, Javascript).
- Documentation of test scenarios with clarity and traceability.

Must have experience with:

- Test plans and cases;

- Manual and automated testing;

- Bug/defect creation and documentation;

- Framework/automation tools (Cypress);

- Azure DevOps, CI/CD;

- Advanced/Intermediate English;

- Main Stacks: JavaScript for automation in Cypress.
